verses.ar: وَالطُّوۡرِۙ‏
verses.en: By the Mount (of Revelation)

verses.ar: وَكِتٰبٍ مَّسۡطُوۡرٍۙ‏
verses.en: By a Decree inscribed

verses.ar: فِيۡ رَقٍّ مَّنۡشُوۡرٍۙ‏
verses.en: In a Scroll unfolded

verses.ar: وَّالۡبَيۡتِ الۡمَعۡمُوۡرِۙ‏
verses.en: By the much-frequented Fane

verses.ar: وَالسَّقۡفِ الۡمَرۡفُوۡعِۙ‏
verses.en: By the Canopy Raised High

verses.ar: وَالۡبَحۡرِ الۡمَسۡجُوۡرِۙ‏
verses.en: And by the Ocean filled with Swell

verses.ar: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌۙ‏
verses.en: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass

verses.ar: مَّا لَهٗ مِنۡ دَافِعٍۙ‏
verses.en: There is none can avert it

verses.ar: يَّوۡمَ تَمُوۡرُ السَّمَآءُ مَوۡرًا
verses.en: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion

verses.ar: وَّتَسِيۡرُ الۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: And the mountains will fly hither and thither

verses.ar: فَوَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِيۡ خَوۡضٍ يَّلۡعَبُوۡنَۘ‏
verses.en: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّوۡنَ اِلٰي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّاؕ‏
verses.en: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly

verses.ar: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
verses.en: This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny

verses.ar: اَفَسِحۡرٌ هٰذَا٘ اَمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see

verses.ar: اِصۡلَوۡهَا فَاصۡبِرُوۡ٘ا اَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُوۡاۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ اِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِيۡمٍۙ‏
verses.en: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness

verses.ar: فٰكِهِيۡنَ بِمَا٘ اٰتٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ وَوَقٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِ
verses.en: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire

verses.ar: كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِيۡٓـًٔاۭ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مَّصۡفُوۡفَةٍۚ وَزَوَّجۡنٰهُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِيۡنٍ
verses.en: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمۡ بِاِيۡمَانٍ اَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَا٘ اَلَتۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ كُلُّ امۡرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِيۡنٌ
verses.en: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds

verses.ar: وَاَمۡدَدۡنٰهُمۡ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّلَحۡمٍ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire

verses.ar: يَتَنَازَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا كَاۡسًا لَّا لَغۡوٌ فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَاۡثِيۡمٌ
verses.en: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill

verses.ar: وَيَطُوۡفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٌ لَّهُمۡ كَاَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٌ مَّكۡنُوۡنٌ
verses.en: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded

verses.ar: وَاَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ يَّتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيۡ٘ اَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people

verses.ar: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقٰىنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوۡمِ
verses.en: But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind

verses.ar: اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوۡهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡبَرُّ الرَّحِيۡمُࣖ‏
verses.en: Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّلَا مَجۡنُوۡنٍؕ‏
verses.en: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَيۡبَ الۡمَنُوۡنِ
verses.en: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time

verses.ar: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُوۡا فَاِنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُتَرَبِّصِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَاۡمُرُهُمۡ اَحۡلَامُهُمۡ بِهٰذَا٘ اَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗۚ بَلۡ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith

verses.ar: فَلۡيَاۡتُوۡا بِحَدِيۡثٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ٘ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا صٰدِقِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth

verses.ar: اَمۡ خُلِقُوۡا مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡخٰلِقُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators

verses.ar: اَمۡ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَۚ بَلۡ لَّا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief

verses.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٌ يَّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ فِيۡهِۚ فَلۡيَاۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍؕ‏
verses.en: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُ الۡبَنٰتُ وَلَكُمُ الۡبَنُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt

verses.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمُ الۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down

verses.ar: اَمۡ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ كَيۡدًاؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا هُمُ الۡمَكِيۡدُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اِلٰهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا كِسۡفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَّقُوۡلُوۡا سَحَابٌ مَّرۡكُوۡمٌ
verses.en: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps

verses.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِيۡ فِيۡهِ يُصۡعَقُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror)

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا عَذَابًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not

verses.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِيۡنَ تَقُوۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth

verses.ar: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَاِدۡبَارَ النُّجُوۡمِࣖ‏
verses.en: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars
